name: socks
description: Website bán tất theo mùa và quà tặng — backend NestJS, frontend Next.js

scripts.build: npm run build -w @socks/backend && npm run build -w @socks/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @socks/backend && npm run lint -w @socks/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @socks/backend && npm run typecheck -w @socks/frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w @socks/backend && npm run format -w @socks/frontend
